generation.scope: For reduced finite windows no constant column combination of a generically invertible opposite matrix has a common factor. Without reducedness any such combination forces a double plane with the proportional contraction. Every fixed-kernel curve in a reduced window has degree at most two, and the quartics in a Bezout presentation are disjoint or, for nonreduced windows, meet only tangentially.
